checks.name: dsp_primitive_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h && test -f Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h && test -f Source/DSP/PitchShifter.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h && test -f Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.h && test -f Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.cpp && test -f tests/TestMain.cpp && test -f tests/DSPPrimitiveTests.cpp

checks.name: dsp_symbols_present
command: rg -q 'class\s+DelayLineFrac' Source/DSP/DelayLineFrac.h && rg -q 'class\s+PitchShifter' Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h && rg -q 'class\s+MonoSafetyCrossover' Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h && rg -q 'class\s+WidthProcessor' Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.h && rg -q 'double' Source/DSP/PitchShifter.h Source/DSP/PitchShifter.cpp && rg -q 'SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER' Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp

checks.name: cmake_registers_dsp_and_tests
command: rg -q 'DelayLineFrac\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'PitchShifter\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'MonoSafetyCrossover\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'WidthProcessor\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'DSPPrimitiveTests\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'add_test' CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: width_ms_math_present
command: rg -q 'setWidth|processSample' Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.h Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.cpp && rg -n 'width' Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.cpp | head -20
